summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mohamed Fornah, a Sierra Leonean international footballer. It states that he was born November 20, 1987 in Freetown, plays as a defender, and was playing for Perseta Tulungagung in the Liga Indonesia Premier Division. It also notes he is a member of the Sierra Leone national team and was part of the Sierra Leone Under-17 squad at the 2005 Mediterranean Cup in Turkey.
one_line: Sierra Leonean defender Mohamed Fornah, born 1987, who played for Perseta Tulungagung and the Sierra Leone national team.
key_facts: Mohamed Fornah was born on November 20, 1987 in Freetown, Sierra Leone.
Mohamed Fornah is a Sierra Leonean international footballer.
Mohamed Fornah plays as a defender.
Mohamed Fornah was playing for Perseta Tulungagung in the Liga Indonesia Premier Division at the time of the note.
Mohamed Fornah is a member of the Sierra Leone National team.
Mohamed Fornah was a member of the Sierra Under-17 squad.
The Sierra Under-17 squad participated at the 2005 Mediterranean Cup in Turkey.
Perseta Tulungagung plays in the Liga Indonesia Premier Division.
